name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-bullet-bill
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Bullet Bill
description:
Originally used in Synthetic Caverns - my CLDC 2023 entry (in its base form), this Bullet Bill was drawn as an alternative to SMW Redrawn's default Bullet Bill graphic for the purposes of contrasting itself more readily from dark backgrounds and having a shape more closely resembling the original SMW Bullet Bill sprite.

Give credit to me for the base graphic, and Moltz for recently drawing diagonal frames on request.

Update: Added Ex-Animation frames for the Bullet Bills based on how the enemies animate in Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-chucks
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Chucks
description: Alternative graphics for Chucks that have a more 3/4ths perspective, this was inspired by the Modern Redrawn Mario released by SF - The Dark Warrior and by the 3/4ths perspective Koopalings made by Moltz, the graphics were made with the blue palette in mind, to change the sprite's palette I would recommend using Tweaker, I also included a patch to fix Diggin' Chuck's shoulder.

name: smwgraphics-antonblast-the-big-bath-main
title: ANTONBLAST - The Big Bath (Main)
description:
Ah yes, the classic poolrooms reference that is the 5th stage in ANTONBLAST, you can use it for pools (obviously) or other water related stages like sewers or something! Huge credit goes to VGrKnoise on The Spriters Resource for ripping these tiles, I only slightly edited them and ported them to SMW, but I also ripped the water palette from the One Blast demo because I've gotta save money for more important things! Or maybe I can buy the full ANTONBLAST game some time in the future...

NOTICE: the water that's already in SMW's files is in this Map16 because I included the water palette and flipped a tile so that you can use it however you'd like

Here's where you can find the original rips:
https://www.spriters-resource.com/pc_computer/antonblast/asset/253627/
https://www.spriters-resource.com/pc_computer/antonblast/asset/254945/

name: smwgraphics-beach-desert
title: Beach / Desert
description:
Originally made in 2017 for one of SF-The Dark Warrior's SMW hack projects, now released at the request of those who want to use it in their desert/beach levels. Best used with Redrawn-styled assets.

Changelog
1.1 - Addressed concerns with the initial removal log (Fixed FG Map16, simplified Palette options to make it less confusing/redundant)

name: smwgraphics-castle-of-illusion-starring-mickey-mouse-castle-act
title: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse - Castle (Act 1)
description:
Ripped from the first area of the Castle in Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse on Genesis/Megadrive.

Observation: Sacrifices two small grass tiles in the FG2 slot. Uses the last colors of palette row 5.

versions.title: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse - Castle (Act 1)
versions.filename: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse - Castle (Act 1) 1.3.zip

name: smwgraphics-castle-of-illusion-starring-mickey-mouse-enchanted-forest-act
title: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse - Enchanted Forest (Act 1)
description: Ripped from the Enchanted Forest's Act 1 in Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse on Genesis/Megadrive.

versions.title: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse - Enchanted Forest (Act 1)
versions.filename: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse - Enchanted Forest (Act 1) (FG).zip

name: smwgraphics-cave-story-outer-wall
title: Cave Story - Outer Wall
description:
This is Outer Wall's background, complete with awesome parallax effect.

UPDATE: Reripped from scratch. Uses a better palette row + uses a tiny bit less GFX space.

The previous UberASM file has been cleaned up, thanks to Arinsu. It includes a pause check, so the background stops when the game is paused.

name: smwgraphics-cute-grasslands
title: Cute Grasslands
description: My first original tileset, pretty simple and cute UwU

name: smwgraphics-fancy-nintendo-logo
title: Fancy Nintendo Logo
description: I wanted to make something to replace that boring old Nintendo Presents logo, so I made this. It's not anything groundbreaking, but I think it's much nicer than leaving the Nintendo logo unchanged.

name: smwgraphics-j-j-squawkers-pistachio-villa-boss-day
title: J.J. Squawkers - Pistachio Villa (Boss, Day)
description: The ocean BG from the 1st stage of J. J. Squawkers, I had to reduce the amount of colors and I couldn't include the clouds because they took too much space in the GFX files

name: smwgraphics-leap-day-forest
title: Leap Day - Forest
description: The forest tileset from Leap Day, a Nitrome mobile game. The tilesets in this game are incredibly crusty, so I manually reduce the amount of colors in them.

name: smwgraphics-leap-day-forest-expanded
title: Leap Day - Forest (Expanded)
description: The forest tileset from Leap Day, now with more stuff I added myself, it's not the most stylistically accurate expansion and I think I took too many creative liberties. On a more important note, I had to split this tileset into 2 files to set in FG3 and BG3 each because I put a lot of new stuff there

name: smwgraphics-leap-day-snow-land
title: Leap Day - Snow Land
description: The Snow Land BG from Nitrome's Leap Day, I had to resize the layer 2 BG because its resolution wasn't a multiple of 8 or 16, plus, sorry if I didn't include the other parts of this BG, you can use this BG for snowy stages, obviously, both vertical and horizontal, if you want to use this BG for horizontal stages, set layer 3's X scrolling to "Variable 2" and its Y scrolling to "None"

name: smwgraphics-madou-monogatari-a-r-s-arle-s-story-cave
title: Madou Monogatari A-R-S: Arle's Story - Cave
description: Ripped from the cave in Madou Monogatari A-R-S: Arle's Story on PC-9801.

versions.title: Madou Monogatari A-R-S: Arle's Story - Cave
versions.filename: Madou Monogatari A-R-S - Arle%27s Story - Cave.zip

name: smwgraphics-metroid-fusion-pipeline-interior-sector
title: Metroid Fusion - Pipeline Interior (Sector 2)
description:
Here's another tileset release at Winter C3 2026.

I had to use Metroid Fusion - Pipeline Interior as reference.

Uses the second half of palette row 4.

Tileset uses level mode 2 as both FG and BG have the same scrolling.

name: smwgraphics-moorhuhn-jewel-of-darkness-ds-brown-bricks
title: Moorhuhn: Jewel of Darkness (DS) - Brown Bricks
description: Some brown brick background from Moorhuhn: Jewel of Darkness for the Nintendo DS.

versions.title: Moorhuhn: Jewel of Darkness (DS) - Brown Bricks
versions.filename: Moorhuhn Jewel Of Darkness DS - Brown Bricks.zip

name: smwgraphics-moorhuhn-jewel-of-darkness-ds-dirt
title: Moorhuhn: Jewel of Darkness (DS) - Dirt
description: Some earthy background from Moorhuhn: Jewel of Darkness for the Nintendo DS. Diggin' for coal!

versions.title: Moorhuhn: Jewel of Darkness (DS) - Dirt
versions.filename: Moorhuhn Jewel Of Darkness DS - Dirt.zip

name: smwgraphics-mr-tuff-temple
title: Mr. Tuff - Temple
description:
Here's the FG of Mr. Tuff - Temple. It's compatible with this BG. Sacrifices palette 4. You'll have to use a different way to add a midpoint or goal to your level.

Enjoy!

name: smwgraphics-new-zealand-story-revolution-auckland-monkeys
title: New Zealand Story Revolution - Auckland (Monkeys)
description: Here's another simple BG from New Zealand Story Revolution on the Nintendo DS, more specifically, the 2nd stage of the 1st world, this world has a lot of different BG's in each level!

name: smwgraphics-new-zealand-story-revolution-waitomo-caves
title: New Zealand Story Revolution - Waitomo Caves
description: The world 3 BG and FG from New Zealand Story Revolution on the Nintendo DS, I had to reduce the colors since the FG tiles had 3 separate palettes each, you can use this BG and FG for cave and town stages, you can even re-arrange the BG as you like, but also, the waterfalls aren't supposed to be animated

versions.title: New Zealand Story Revolution - Waitomo Caves

name: smwgraphics-paperboy-nes-font
title: Paperboy (NES) - Font
description: The font used in the menus and news headlines of Paperboy (NES)

name: smwgraphics-pokey-heading-needlenose
title: Pokey Heading + Needlenose
description:
A redrawn styled version of this sprite, it comes with two variants one with white teeth based on their Yoshi's Island artwork and one with green teeth based in the Yoshi's New Island design.

The Needlenose from YI New Island was made by Moltz.

name: smwgraphics-puggsy-genesis-darkskull-castle
title: Puggsy (Genesis) - Darkskull Castle
description: The Darkskull Castle BG from Puggsy on the Sega Genesis, I ripped it from Junior stage 3 because I don't know how to disable this game's anti-piracy measures on Gens KMod, which is the emulator I'm using to rip this BG

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-baron-von-zeppelin-needlenose
title: Redrawn Styled Baron von Zeppelin + Needlenose
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for Yoshi Island's Baron von Zeppelin custom sprite recreation from smkdan and Dr. Anas, meant to make the enemy fit SMW Redrawn's art style.

It also includes graphics for the cactus-like enemy it can drop (Needlenose), included with the balloon.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Baron von Zeppelin + Needlenose

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-ghost-guy-snufit
title: Redrawn Styled Ghost Guy & Snufit
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for the custom sprite recreations of the Ghost Guy (bu smkdan) and Snufit enemies (by RussianMan) respectively.

Multiple variations are included depending on what palettes the Snufits look best with (+ one that invokes the enemy's design from Super Mario 64). Similarly, the Ghost Guy has 2 variations based on whether its mask is closer to Icegoom's Shy Guy, or if it uses a custom mask of my own design.

Finally, the custom palette included also comes with a palette for the Ghoul Guy variation of Ghost Guy seen in Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time. As this one's set in Palette E, using it requires changing Ghost Guy's color through PIXI's CFG editor to apply it.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-jelectro
title: Redrawn Styled Jelectro
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for the SMB3 Enemy/Solid Hazard Jelectro, meant to resemble the jellyfish's official artwork.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-joe-the-shark
title: Redrawn Styled Joe The Shark
description: A redrawn styled version of this sprite, It comes with two variants for grey and blue palettes and 3 other variants for how the vertical Joe looks, They were based on how they looked in their Super Mario Land 2 artworks.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-reznor-family
title: Redrawn Styled Reznor Family
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for the whole Reznor family, meant to resemble the dino's redesign from New Super Mario Bros 2. This pack includes:
* Graphics for SMW Vanilla Reznor + the platform they're in.
* Graphics for Koopster's Baby Reznor custom sprite.
* A custom Sprite Palette 2, meant to be used with the family.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-rideable-balloon
title: Redrawn Styled Rideable Balloon
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for Yoshi Island's Rideable Balloon custom sprite recreation from smkdan. It comes with 2 variations; normal, and with a blush.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-serpont
title: Redrawn Styled Serpont
description:
A redrawn version of this sprite, the standart version for their graphics uses palette 8 for their pot (to ressemble their design in wonder), but you can use a lot of other palettes as seen in the screenshots, there's also a version of the graphics with an orange pot to ressemble their original graphics and a custom purple palette that goes over palette B.
Note that you should use the sprite's extension to customize the appearence of the pot, for the standart appearence I used: C0 and 21 for the two first values, C0 being the tile for the pot, 2 being the tile priority and 1 the palette the tile should use.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-shymore-shyster
title: Redrawn Styled Shymore/Shyster
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for imamelia's Super Mario RPG Shymore/Shyster Custom Sprite recreation, meant to make the enemy fit its more modern design from the Super Mario RPG Switch remake.

Multiple variations are included depending on what palettes the Shy Guys riding the claymore-looking pogo-sticks look best with. Variations A to D use Icegoom's masks for Super Mario World Redrawn's Shy Guys, while variations E & F use a custom mask of my own design.

Similarly, 3 different custom palettes are included which give the pogo-sticks different colors: green, red, and gray/silver.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-spark
title: Redrawn Styled Spark
description: A redrawn styled version of this sprite, It comes with variants for the Doki Doki design and Yoshi's Island design.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-tap-tap
title: Redrawn Styled Tap-Tap
description:
A redrawn version this sprite, comes with two versions, the first one is a newer version I made more recently, the second one is an older attempt I did at redrawing the Tap-Taps wich looks closer to the Yoshi's Island graphics.

They come with four variants each: blue shoes, red shoes, one that only uses 8 colors and one that's compatible with more common palettes like pal A, B, C or D (the green palette shown here is more so for show since it can also be used with original SMW palettes).

name: smwgraphics-snow-bros-2-with-new-elves-world-1
title: Snow Bros. 2: With New Elves - World 1-1
description: Here's the BG from the 1st stage from Snow Bros. 2, I had to change this BG's Layout to make it loop properly. In the original game, it had 5 palettes, so I had to reduce the amount of colors, because some looked a bit too similar to each other, and it had so many tiles that I had to separate them into 2 layers, I recommend y'all to set Layer 3's X scrolling to "Variable 2" and its Y scrolling to "Variable" if you want to use this BG, I'd recommend you to use a patch that deletes the layer 3 status bar or completely replaces it with a sprite status bar

versions.title: Snow Bros. 2: With New Elves - World 1-1

name: smwgraphics-snow-bros-2-with-new-elves-world-2
title: Snow Bros. 2: With New Elves - World 2-2
description: The beanstalk waterfall BG from Snow Bros. 2, I had to separate this BG into 2 separate layers, make sure to set layer 3's X scrolling to "Variable" and its Y scrolling to "Auto-Scroll Down Normal", plus, you need to use a patch to remove the layer 3 status bar or a patch to replace it with a sprite status bar

versions.title: Snow Bros. 2: With New Elves - World 2-2

name: smwgraphics-soul-blazer-dr-leo-s-laboratory-first-and-second-floors
title: Soul Blazer - Dr. Leo's Laboratory (First and Second Floors)
description:
The mechanical components seen through cracks and holes of the first and second floors of Dr. Leo's Laboratory, from the Quintet's cult classic game: Soul Blazer. While this graphic was meant for a top down view perspective, it works fine in a 2D platformer perspective.

You'll need to disable the status bar if you wanna use this full layer 3 background. A good fit for mechanical or industrial levels.

versions.title: Soul Blazer - Dr. Leo's Laboratory (First and Second Floors)
versions.filename: Soul Blazer - Leo%27s Laboratory (First %26 Second Floors).zip

name: smwgraphics-soul-blazer-main-map-magridd-castle-area
title: Soul Blazer - Main Map (Magridd Castle Area)
description:
The dark clouds seen in the upper right half of the main map from Quintet's cult classic: Soul Blazer. I thought it looked pretty enough, so I converted it for use in Super Mario World hacks.

You can, optionally, add some parallax scrolling to this background.

A good fit for night sky themed levels.

versions.title: Soul Blazer - Main Map (Magridd Castle Area)
versions.filename: Soul Blazer - Main Map (Magridd Castle Area).zip

name: smwgraphics-soul-blazer-world-of-evil-dazzling-space
title: Soul Blazer -  World of Evil (Dazzling Space)
description:
The Dazzling Space section of World of Evil, from the Quintet's cult classic game: Soul Blazer.

In the original game, there's a wavy effect with it, but I don't think it's necessary to make this background to work.

The sample level includes the ideal autoscrolling speed and how it's meant to be used. A good fit for horror themed areas.

versions.title: Soul Blazer -  World of Evil (Dazzling Space)
versions.filename: Soul Blazer - World of Evil (Dazzling Space).zip

name: smwgraphics-super-double-dragon-airport-runway
title: Super Double Dragon - Airport Runway
description: This was taken from Super Double Dragon, on a stage on a runway. It's very beautiful because of the colors of the lights. It's a shame it doesn't have an original animation.

name: smwgraphics-super-fantasy-zone-stage
title: Super Fantasy Zone - Stage 4: Risscave
description: The 4th stage in Super Fantasy Zone on the Sega Genesis, I don't really know how to animate palettes but I think it's fine as it is right now. The BG and the FG were on the same layer in the original game but this isn't much of a problem here since this stage is shrouded in darkness and you've gotta buy some super lights to light up the stage, still in the original game. Adding some parallax scrolling (like in the original game) is highly recommended for this BG.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-super-mario-bros
title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Desert
description:
I found this background in the first castle of SMAS 3 and decided to put it next to its layer 3. They are available here.
I also put the animation of the lamps above the background.

The foreground can be found here!

versions.title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Desert
Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Castle
Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Treasure Ship

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-super-mario-world
title: Super Mario World Styled Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Forest
description: The forest background from Yoshi's Island but now fits with the art style from Super Mario World. It's uses a mix of custom and vanilla background tiles from the original SMW and SMM2's SMW Forest Theme.

versions.title: Super Mario World Styled Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Forest
versions.filename: SMW Syled SMW2 Yoshi%27s Island - Forest Background.zip

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-western-badlands
title: Super Mario World Styled Western Badlands
description:
In case you ever wondered what the typical Minecraft badlands would look like in Super Mario World.

Made by Blizzard Buffalo

versions.title: Super Mario World Styled Western Badlands

name: smwgraphics-super-ninja-boy-rainforest
title: Super Ninja Boy - Rainforest
description:
A surprisingly simple, but yet, colorful background seen in battles taken in rainforests, from Super Ninja Boy, also known as Super Chinese World.

A good fit for swamp or jungle levels.

Status bar colors are unaffected.

name: smwgraphics-the-pigeon
title: The Pigeon
description:
The Pigeon from "Don't Let the Pigeon Drive the Bus!" Books by Mo Willems, in the style of SMW.

Contains:
HUD Graphics
Blush Graphics (Vanilla Bowser Fight)
Overworld Mario
Level Mario
Palette for Luigi, called "DOVEY"

Requires the 32x32 gfx patch.

name: smwgraphics-the-wizard-of-oz-snes-forest
title: The Wizard of Oz (SNES) - Forest
description:
C3 WINTER 2026 - SISTER EDITION:

The "Forest" from The Wizard of Oz Super Nintendo game.
What do you think about this?
